title: I added cinematic boss entrances and death animations to Tower Legends !
author: Traditional_End_743
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I've been working on making boss fights feel more epic in **Tower Legends**, my solo-developed tower defense game.

Bosses now have their own cinematic entrances and death animations, giving these encounters a bit more personality and making victories feel more rewarding.

Here's a short clip showing the new animations!

**Demo and Full Game available on Steam:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower\_Legends/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5012660/Tower_Legends/)

comments.author: iagamedev_gsc
comments.body:
Excelente! 
Pode me descrever como fez? Voce criou as animações separadas e depois adicinou ao jogo, ou criou um Prompt para definir as animações é já tinha o modelo no jogo?

replies.author: Traditional_End_743
replies.body:
That’s actually pretty interesting.

My game is web-based (Typescript using Phaser) so I used Claude Sonnet 5.5 to create a kind of storyboard for the animation, and it managed to generate all the VFX without relying on any assets. Everything was procedurally generated (Lightnings, ground effect etc.. see video) using canvas drawings.

I then replaced some of the procedural drawings with generated images, tweaked the colors, etc.

I feel like the overall result looks pretty good!

First animation shot:

https://reddit.com/link/pgvkmpr/video/yd2htlj26mvh1/player

comments.author: ganJscopez
comments.body: The boss animations look good but you should definitely clean up your sprites, there's tons of white pixels and jagged edges in your animations which make them look unfinished or placeholders. Highly recommend you feather them out.

replies.author: Traditional_End_743
replies.body: Thank you. You are right and this is particularly visible for large bosses. I will definitely take time to cleanup the sprites.
